title: The Poor Noob Who Secretly Owned the School

lines.text: Get out of our way, broke noob!
Look at his cheap bacon hair and dusty jacket. He doesn't even belong here.
lines.caps: Cheap *bacon hair | and *dusty jacket. | Doesn't *belong here.

lines.text: At lunch, Leo tried to sit at the empty table, but the three rich kids blocked his tray.
lines.caps: Leo tried | to *sit down, | rich kids *blocked him.

lines.text: Sit on the floor where you belong, they laughed, as everyone stared.
lines.caps: Sit on the *floor! | they *laughed, | as *everyone stared.

lines.text: Leo didn't say a word. He just picked up his tray and walked away.
lines.caps: Leo didn't | say a *word. | Just *walked away.

lines.text: They had no idea what his family was about to do that very night.
lines.caps: They had *no idea | what his *family | did *that night.

lines.text: The next morning, the principal called an emergency assembly for the whole school.
lines.caps: The *next morning, | *emergency assembly | for the *whole school.

lines.text: Attention students! Our school has officially been bought by a billionaire new owner.
lines.caps: Our school | has been *bought | by a *billionaire!

lines.text: The three bullies smirked, bragging that it had to be one of their rich dads.
lines.caps: The bullies *smirked, | bragging it was | their *rich dads.

lines.text: Whoever owns this place is kicking that noob out today, they whispered.
Minutes later, the principal's office door swung open, and everyone froze in shock.
Leo walked straight past the bullies, wearing the same blue shirt and bacon hair.
lines.caps: *Leo walked past, | same *blue shirt | and *bacon hair.

lines.text: Welcome, sir, the principal bowed, handing Leo the golden deed to the school.
Leo turned to the pale bullies and smiled: Guess I'm not sitting on the floor today.
lines.caps: Leo *smiled: | Not sitting on | the *floor today.

lines.text: The same three kids who mocked him dropped to their knees, begging for forgiveness.
Because in life, you never know who the quiet kid really is.
lines.caps: You *never know | who the *quiet kid | *really is.
